get.summary: Retrieve class status list with filtering, sorting, and pagination support
get.description:
Retrieves the complete list of available statuses for a specific class type (e.g., Orders, Quotes, Returns, Carts).

Returns all statuses configured for the specified class type (e.g., orders, quotes, returns). Each status includes its name, code, and display properties. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

Use this endpoint to populate status filter dropdowns or status transition menus.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:** `filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| StatusName | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), is (Is), or (OR), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| Description | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), is (Is), or (OR), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StatusCode | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), is (Is), or (OR), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StatusId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| IsEdit | eq (Equals) |
| IsOrderLineItemState | eq (Equals) |
| IsOrderState | eq (Equals) |

### Sort Support

**Sort Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Sortable |
|-------|----------|
| StatusName | Yes |
| Description | Yes |
| IsEdit | Yes |
| StatusCode | Yes |
| StatusId | Yes |
| IsOrderLineItemState | Yes |

**Default Sort:** `OrderStateName ASC`

---

### Examples

| Use Case | Request |
|----------|---------|
| Filter by name | `filter=StatusName~cn~Pending` |
| Filter by code | `filter=StatusCode~eq~SUBMITTED` |
| Filter editable | `filter=IsEdit~eq~true` |
| Sort by name | `sort=StatusName~asc` |
| Sort by ID desc | `sort=StatusId~desc` |

**Reference:** For complete filter syntax, supported operators, pagination, and sorting usage, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/lmod0vga5s303-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

get.summary: Check if an approved return exists for a specific order number
get.description:
**Purpose**

This API is intended for specific scenarios and is used to validate whether a **return request has already been created and approved** for a given order number.
The API does not provide return details or order-related information. It only verifies whether an **approved return exists** for the provided order number.

**Description**

This endpoint checks whether a return associated with the specified order number has already been **created and approved** in the system.
When the request is processed, the system validates the provided order number and determines whether any return associated with that order has reached the **APPROVED** status.
If an approved return is found, the API returns a successful response indicating that the return has been created. Otherwise, the response indicates that no approved return exists for the order.

**Response Behavior**

- **true -** Returned when approved return exists for the given order number.
- **false -** Returned when no approved return exists for the given order number.

**Notes**

- This API only verifies whether an **approved return exists** for the provided order number.
- It does **not provide return details, return history, or order information**.
- If an order contains multiple line items, **multiple return requests may be created** for the same order number.
- Each return request will have its **own unique return identifier**, while the original order number remains the same.
- The response only indicates whether **any approved return exists**, and does not provide information about the number of returns or their statuses.

post.summary: Validate return eligibility for an order based on rules and returnable items
post.description:
Validates whether a specific order is eligible for return based on the order number, order status, defined return rules, item condition, and returnable quantity. If line items are provided in the request body, the API validates those specific line items first; otherwise, it validates the entire order by class number.

---

### Status-Ineligible Line Items

A line item whose current order status does not allow returns is reported as a validation entry with `IsStatusIneligible` set to `true`. These entries identify the specific line items that cannot be returned and do not change `IsSuccess` on their own.

The status code depends on the entries in `ValidationDetails`:

- **`200`** - The list is empty, or every entry has `IsStatusIneligible` set to `true`. The response body contains the full validation list.
- **`404`** - At least one entry has `IsStatusIneligible` set to `false`, such as a quantity or order-level failure. The response body contains the full validation list, including any status-ineligible entries.

A `404` with an error body is also returned when the order cannot be found.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Create a return for an order.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/b8f971505d428)
- **`PUT`** [Update an existing return.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/bca9d7faad642)
- **`GET`** [Check if a return exists for an order.](1aa429a449b4c-check-if-an-approved-return-exists-for-an-order)

post.summary: Add one or more line items to an existing class of any type
post.description:
Adds one or more line items to an existing class (cart, order, quote, or saved cart).

Accepts a list of products with SKUs and quantities to add. Each item is validated for product availability, inventory stock, and pricing rules. The class totals are recalculated after all items are added.

This is the primary endpoint for adding products to any class type.

### Important Note: AdditionalCost Behaviour

#### AdditionalCost Updates
 If the same product is added again with the **same AdditionalCost Code**, the existing AdditionalCost value is updated.

 **Example:**
  - Request 1: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `2`, AdditionalCost `UPCHARGE = 200`
  - Request 2: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `3`, AdditionalCost `UPCHARGE = 500`
  - Result: Quantity becomes `5` and `UPCHARGE` is updated from `200` to `500`.

#### New AdditionalCost Codes Are Not Added to Existing Line Items
 If a product already exists with an AdditionalCost Code and a subsequent request includes a different AdditionalCost Code, no new AdditionalCost entry is added to the existing line item.

 **Example:**
  - Request 1: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `2`, AdditionalCost `UPCHARGE = 200`
  - Request 2: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `3`, AdditionalCost `SERVICEFEE = 100`
  - Result: Quantity becomes `5`. Existing `UPCHARGE` remains unchanged. `SERVICEFEE` is ignored and is not added.

#### Existing AdditionalCost Persists
 If a product already has an AdditionalCost and a subsequent request does not include the same AdditionalCost Code, the existing AdditionalCost remains unchanged.

  **Example:**
   - Request 1: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `2`, AdditionalCost `UPCHARGE = 200`
   - Request 2: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `3`, AdditionalCost not provided
   - Result: Quantity becomes `5` and `UPCHARGE = 200` remains applied.

#### Adding AdditionalCost to an Existing Product
 If a product was originally added without an AdditionalCost and a subsequent request includes an AdditionalCost Code, the AdditionalCost is added to the existing line item.

  **Example:**
  - Request 1: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `2`
   - Request 2: Product SKU `z-10076`, Quantity `3`, AdditionalCost `UPCHARGE = 200`
   - Result: Quantity becomes `5` and `UPCHARGE = 200` is added to the line item. 

### Additional Cost Validation Rules

 - CostType is optional and can be set to null when there is only one additional cost entry for a given Code and Value within a line item. 
 - If multiple additional cost entries exist for the same line item with the same Code and Value, CostType is mandatory to differentiate those entries. 
 - When CostType is provided, the combination of SKU, Code, and CostType must be unique within the same line item. Duplicate combinations are not allowed. 

 **Example:**
 SKU: 'Z-100226' Code: 'Upcharge' CostType: 'FrontLogo' 

### Recommended Approach

put.summary: Update shipping address
put.description:
Updates the shipping address for the checkout class identified by **`ClassNumber`**.

This endpoint allows customers to update their shipping address while progressing through the checkout process, before the final order submission. The request remains scoped to the active checkout context associated with the specified **`ClassNumber`**.

### Address Type Support
The API supports different address types through the optional **`AddressType`** request parameter. This parameter determines how the provided **`ShippingAddressId`** should be validated before it is applied to the checkout/order. If **`AddressType`** is not provided, is null, empty, or contains only whitespace, the API defaults to **`UserAccount`** to maintain backward compatibility.

**Supported Address Types:**

- **`UserAccount`** (Default) – Validates that the provided address is associated with the specified user or account before applying it to the checkout/order. IDOR validation is applied when enabled.
- **`Warehouse`** – Validates that the provided address belongs to a warehouse configured for the same portal as the checkout/order. The validation confirms that the warehouse associated with the address is mapped to the portal being used for the checkout/order. A warehouse can be associated with multiple portals.
- **`StoreLocator`** – Validates that the provided address belongs to a store locator configured for the same portal as the checkout/order. The validation confirms that the address is associated with a store locator available for the portal being used for the checkout/order.
- **`Custom`** – Validates that the provided address exists in the system without applying user or account ownership validation.

### IDOR Validation Behavior
IDOR validation is applied **only when** **`AddressType`** is **`UserAccount`** (including when **`AddressType`** is not provided and defaults to **`UserAccount`**). For other address types (**`Warehouse`**, **`StoreLocator`**, and **`Custom`**), user/account-based IDOR validation is skipped because these address types are not associated with a specific user or user account.

### Identity and Access Rules
- The caller identity is supplied through the required **`Znode-UserId`** header.
- The **`Znode-AccountId`** header is optional and should be supplied only when the caller is associated with a B2B account.
- The **`AddressType`** parameter determines how the provided address is validated and which IDOR rules apply. See **Address Type Support** section for details.
- The request body does not include a `UserId` field.
- Address validation is skipped when the **`dontSaveAddress`** future-use flag is set to `true`.

### IDOR Validation (Legacy)
This API supports **IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation** when the **`EnableIdorValidation`** setting is enabled and **`AddressType`** is **`UserAccount`** (or not provided).

When enabled, IDOR validation uses the **`Z-Request-Context`** request header to ensure the caller can only access and update the checkout data they are authorized to use.

> **Note:** IDOR validation is applied **only when** **`AddressType`** is **`UserAccount`** (including when **`AddressType`** is not provided and defaults to **`UserAccount`**). For other address types (**`Warehouse`**, **`StoreLocator`**, and **`Custom`**), user/account-based IDOR validation is skipped because these address types are not associated with a specific user or user account.

**Backward Compatibility:** If the **`Z-Request-Context`** header is not provided, the API continues with its existing behavior and IDOR validation is not applied.

---

### Related APIs

- **`PUT`** [Create or update shipping and shipment details on an existing order](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/70418a2248497)
- **`DELETE`** [Remove Shipping Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/branches/main/3b7961…emove-shipping-details-from-a-cart-order-or-quote)

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList)

requestBody.description: Payload used to update shipment address for the selected class context. User identity is supplied through the required `Znode-UserId` header, and the optional `Znode-AccountId` header is used for account-scoped validation when applicable. The request body contains `ShippingAddressId` (required) and optional `AddressType` to specify the type of address being used. The request does not include a `UserId` field.

ShippingAddressId.description: Shipping address identifier to apply to the target class context. This value identifies the address that will be used for the shipment, and its validation depends on the `AddressType` parameter.

AddressType.description:
Specifies the type of shipping address provided through `ShippingAddressId`. The selected address type determines how the address is validated before it is applied to the checkout/order.

**Supported Values:**
- **`UserAccount`** – Address associated with the specified user or account. IDOR validation is applied. This is the default when `AddressType` is not provided, is null, empty, or contains only whitespace.
- **`Warehouse`** – Address belonging to a warehouse configured for the same portal as the checkout/order.
- **`StoreLocator`** – Address associated with a store locator available for the portal being used for the checkout/order.
- **`Custom`** – Address that exists in the system without user or account ownership validation.

**Default Behavior:** If not provided or null, defaults to `UserAccount`.

200.description: **OK** - The shipment address was updated successfully for the requested class context. Returns a lightweight confirmation payload containing the class number and operation success flag.

ClassNumber.description: The unique class number for which the shipment address update operation was executed.

IsSuccess.description: Indicates whether the shipment address update operation completed successfully.

400.description:

- Invalid or malformed `classNumber` format
- Missing required `ShippingAddressId` field in request body
- `ShippingAddressId` value is less than 1 (must be positive integer)
- Invalid `AddressType` value (not one of: UserAccount, Warehouse, StoreLocator, Custom)
- Shipping address ID not found in system
- Address not valid or authorized for the specified `AddressType`
- Address does not exist or is not associated with a warehouse or store locator configured for the current portal.
- Provided address is not mapped to the portal associated with the checkout/order.

post.summary: (Deprecated) Add one or more products to a shopping cart with quantity and options
post.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `POST /carts/items` instead.

Adds one or more products to a shopping cart.

Creates a new cart if no cart number is provided, or adds items to an existing cart. The request body must include the product SKU(s) and quantities. The endpoint validates inventory availability, applies tier pricing rules, and calculates item-level totals. 

### Additional Cost Validation Rules

 - CostType is optional and can be set to null when there is only one additional cost entry for a given Code and Value within a line item. 
 - If multiple additional cost entries exist for the same line item with the same Code and Value, CostType is mandatory to differentiate those entries. 
 - When CostType is provided, the combination of SKU, Code, and CostType must be unique within the same line item. Duplicate combinations are not allowed. 

 **Example:**
 SKU: 'Z-100226' Code: 'Upcharge' CostType: 'FrontLogo' 

---

### Backorder Estimate

When the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled, adding items to a cart also saves the estimated backorder quantity and date against the cart line items. The estimate is recalculated when the order is placed. A failure to save the estimate does not affect the add-to-cart result, and the response body is unchanged.

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Get cart items.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/c94c72726ba3e)
- **`DELETE`** [Delete all items from a cart.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/c89a9d560f592)

get.description:
Calculates and returns the complete pricing breakdown for a cart.

Performs a full recalculation of the cart totals including subtotal, item-level discounts, order-level discounts, tax (based on the shipping address), shipping costs, and grand total. Use this endpoint after any cart modification to get accurate pricing. If the cart has a shipping address, tax and shipping costs are included in the response.

Use the `expand` query parameter to include additional pricing components (Discount, Shipping, Tax, Voucher) in the response. By default, only **SubTotal** and **Total** are returned. See the `expand` parameter documentation below for supported keys and usage examples.

get.summary: (Deprecated) Retrieve order tracking details by order number and email address
get.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `GET /orders/{classNumber}/tracking?emailAddress=` instead.

Retrieves comprehensive tracking information for a specific order identified by its order number and the customer's email address.

Returns order status, line items, shipment details including carrier tracking numbers, payment summary, and estimated delivery timeline. The email address serves as a customer verification step, enabling guest users to track their orders without an account.

---

### Backorder Information

Each line item in the response, and each bundle, grouped or configurable child item and add-on, can include **BackOrderQuantity** and **BackOrderDate**, together with a **BackOrderDetails** list of all backordered SKUs.

- **Carts, checkout and quotes** - an estimate based on current inventory, returned only when the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled. When the setting is off, no backorder details are returned. For carts and checkout, the estimate is also saved with the line items.
- **Orders** - the quantity and date saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.
- **Approval-routed (pending) orders** - the values saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.

- **`POST`** [Create an order.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/b8a612d19b739)

get.summary: (Deprecated) Retrieve the list of line items for a specific class of any type
get.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `GET /{classType}/{classNumber}/items` instead.

Returns the list of line items (products, SKUs, quantities, pricing) associated with a specific class. Use this to inspect the contents of an order, cart, quote, or saved cart before further processing.

**Related APIs:**
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Class Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/808308a389044)
- **`POST`** [Add Line Items to a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/128e56dad49c0)
- **`PUT`** [Update Bulk Quantity on a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/ce30892f52bf6)
- **`PUT`** [Update Custom Data on a Line Item](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/44cd33ffd1728)  

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

### Backorder Information

Each line item, and each bundle, grouped or configurable child item and add-on, can include **BackOrderQuantity** and **BackOrderDate**, together with a **BackOrderDetails** list of all backordered SKUs.

- **Carts, checkout and quotes** - an estimate based on current inventory, returned only when the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled. When the setting is off, no backorder details are returned. For carts and checkout, the estimate is also saved with the line items.
- **Orders** - the quantity and date saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.
- **Approval-routed (pending) orders** - the values saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.

get.summary: (Deprecated) Retrieve complete details for a specific class of any class type
get.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `GET /{classType}/{classNumber}` instead.

Returns the full detail record for a specific class (order, cart, quote, or saved cart), including header information, address, line items, shipments, discounts, payment details, and pricing totals.

**Related APIs:**
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Item List for a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/632718385de54)
- **`POST`** [Place an Order](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/829b5bf9bdff7)
- **`PUT`** [Finalize a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/6b576bf493d0a)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Multiple Class Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/02e9ca24d8980) 

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

### Backorder Information

Each line item in the response, and each bundle, grouped or configurable child item and add-on, can include **BackOrderQuantity** and **BackOrderDate**, together with a **BackOrderDetails** list of all backordered SKUs.

- **Carts, checkout and quotes** - an estimate based on current inventory, returned only when the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled. When the setting is off, no backorder details are returned. For carts and checkout, the estimate is also saved with the line items.
- **Orders** - the quantity and date saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.
- **Approval-routed (pending) orders** - the values saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.

post.summary: (Deprecated) Copy an existing class into a new class
post.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `POST /{classType}/{classNumber}/copy` instead.

Creates a copy of an existing class (cart, order, quote, or saved cart) into a new class of the type specified by `TargetClassType`. Use this to duplicate content for reorders, templates, or workflow transitions without modifying the original.

On success, the response returns the class number of the newly copied class.

> **Authentication required** — see the Authorization header in the Request section.

**Warning:** Each invocation of this API creates a new class copy and generates a new class number. Repeated calls for the same source class will result in multiple duplicate class records being created in the database. Since this is a resource-intensive operation involving bulk data copy, unnecessary or repeated executions can lead to data duplication and may negatively impact system performance. It is strongly recommended to check for an existing active copied class (for example, an existing Quote Number) and reuse it whenever possible, rather than invoking this API multiple times.

### Same-User Copy
 

- The copied class is created under the **same user** who owns the source class.
- No additional validations are executed — no user lookup, no account check, no portal access check.
- Order addresses, `OrderAddressId` on payment, and `OrderAddressId` on shipment are all **preserved as-is** on the copied quote.
     
### Scope

The `{classType}` route parameter is generic and the endpoint accepts any class type (`Quotes`, `Carts`, `Orders`, `SavedCarts`, `OrderTemplates`, `ApprovalRoutings`, etc.).

### What Gets Copied

| Data | Same-User Copy  |
|---|---|
| Line items, quantities, custom data, configuration | ✅ Copied | 
| Payment details (totals, card type, payment token) | ✅ Copied |
| Discount details | ✅ Copied |
| Order addresses (`ZnodeOrderAddress`) | ✅ Copied — source address rows merged into target order |
| `OrderAddressId` FK in `ZnodeOrderAddress` | ✅ Preserved — points to the copied billing address row |
| `OrderAddressId` FK in `ZnodeOrderShipment` | ✅ Preserved — points to the copied shipping address row |
| Pricing, account pricing tiers, promotions | ❌ **Not recalculated** — prices are carried over as-is |
| Obsolete or inactive products | ⚠️ Copied as-is — no availability check at copy time |

> ⚠️ **Credit card orders:** It is recommended not to copy classes that were placed using a credit card.

### Post-Copy Recommended Actions

The following endpoints bring the copied quote to a consistent state. They apply to **copies** — prices are never recalculated at copy time regardless of copy type.

- **POST** [Reset prices of specified order line items to their original catalog prices](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/bb8bf67690641-reset-prices-of-specified-order-line-items-to-their-original-catalog-prices) - ```/commerceapi/v1/lineitems/reset-line-item-prices```
	- Resets the prices of specified line items to their current catalog prices, applying tier pricing, account pricing, and promotions for the target user. Call this after a copy to ensure the copied quote reflects the target user's correct pricing rather than the source user's prices.
- **GET** [Validate all cart items for inventory, pricing, and product status](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/d488b6863ed23-validate-all-cart-items-for-inventory-pricing-and-product-status-issues) - ```/commerceapi/v1/carts/validate-cart/{cartNumber}```
	- Validates **all** line items in a quote/cart in a single call. More efficient than validating items one-by-one when the copied quote may contain many line items.

**Related APIs:**
- `GET` [Retrieve a paginated list of order classes from a cached source](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Get-Classes/List) — Retrieves a paginated list of order classes from a cached source.
- `GET` [Retrieve order class details by the provided unique order class identi](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Get-Classes/OrderClass) — Retrieves order class details by the provided unique order class identifier.
- `PUT` [Update an existing order class configuration using the provided reques](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Put-Classes/Update) — Updates an existing order class configuration using the provided request.
- `DELETE` [Delete an order class identified by its unique CP order class identifi](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Delete-Classes/Delete) — Deletes an order class identified by its unique CP order class identifier.

delete.summary: (Deprecated) Remove all line items from a class while preserving the class shell
delete.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `DELETE /{classType}/{classNumber}/items` instead.

Permanently removes all line items from the specified class (order, cart, quote, or saved cart), leaving the class shell intact. The class record itself is preserved — only its line items are deleted.

**Related APIs:**
- **`DELETE`** [Delete a Line Item from a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/d14efb6187312)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Item List for a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/632718385de54)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Class Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/808308a389044)
- **`POST`** [Add Line Items to a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/128e56dad49c0) 

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

get.summary: (Deprecated) Retrieve the approver list and routing details for an order class
get.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `GET /approval-routings/{classNumber}/approvers` instead.

Retrieves the list of approvers configured for the specified order class. Returns approval routing details including each approver's name, position in the approval chain, current approval status, and the date the approval decision was made.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| ApproverName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), is (Is), in (In), or (OR), not in (NotIn), ncn (NotContains), bw (Between), nlk (NotLike) |
| StatusCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), is (Is), in (In), or (OR), not in (NotIn), ncn (NotContains), bw (Between), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**

- `filter=ApproverName~cn~John`
- `filter=StatusCode~eq~Approved`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/4snv30ex9ae4k-5-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ApproverOrder | Sort by the approver's position in the approval chain. |
| ApproverName | Sort by the name of the approver. |
| StatusCode | Sort by the approval status code. |
| ApprovalDate | Sort by the date the approval decision was made. |

**Example:**

- `sort=ApproverOrder~asc`
- `sort=ApprovalDate~desc`

---

### Pagination

Supports `pageIndex` and `pageSize` parameters. See [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/4snv30ex9ae4k-5-filters-pagination-and-sorting) for details.

---

### Related APIs

post.summary: Create a return request for one or more line items on an order
post.description:
Creates a return request for an order.

Initiates a return (RMA) for one or more line items from the specified order. The return request includes the items being returned, return quantities, return reasons, and requested refund method. The return is created in a pending state awaiting review and approval.

---

### Related APIs

- **`PUT`** [Update an existing return.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/bca9d7faad642)
- **`POST`** [Validate return eligibility for an order.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/fcf72e28a5e72)
- **`GET`** [Check if a return exists for an order.](1aa429a449b4c-check-if-an-approved-return-exists-for-an-order) 

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

get.summary: (Deprecated) Validate Checkout Session
get.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `GET /checkout/{classNumber}/validate` instead.

Validates the current state of a checkout snapshot identified by the provided classNumber.

In the default implementation, this endpoint is invoked only during the final checkout transaction steps to ensure that the checkout session is still valid before executing an irreversible action.

The validation is performed before the following operations:
- Place Order
- Submit for Approval
- Pay & Submit (Online Payment)

If the checkout snapshot is no longer valid, the requested operation is blocked and an appropriate response is returned to the client.

A checkout snapshot may become invalid for reasons such as:
- The checkout session has expired.
- A newer checkout snapshot has been created for the same cart.
- The checkout has been opened or continued in another tab or browser session, making the previous snapshot inactive.
- The provided checkout reference or class number is invalid.
- The checkout session no longer exists.

> **Note:** In the default implementation, checkout snapshot validation is performed only before the final transaction steps and is not continuously executed throughout the checkout flow. This behavior can be customized based on business requirements.

**Related APIs:**
- **`POST`** [Copy a Class (Create Checkout Snapshot)](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/37f377d95d2ec)
- **`POST`** [Place an Order](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/829b5bf9bdff7)

parameters.name: classNumber
parameters.description:
**Class Number** - The unique checkout snapshot number to validate (e.g., `CO-07042026-03375`).

> **Note:** The checkout snapshot `classNumber` is not displayed in the Admin application. It is available only in the response of the Copy Class API when the checkout snapshot is created.

**Reference:** [List of classes of specified class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/f3b6637fbc23d)

200.description: **OK** - The checkout snapshot validation completed. The response contains the snapshot state, expiry date, and any error message.

204.description: **No Content** - The validation completed but produced no result. The checkout snapshot may not exist or the session produced no state.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request is invalid. This occurs when `classNumber` is missing or not in the correct format.

value.ErrorMessage: Invalid or missing classNumber parameter.

401.description: **Unauthorized** - The request failed because the Authorization header is missing or the token/API key is invalid or expired.

value.ErrorMessage: Authorization failed. Invalid or missing credentials.

404.description: **Not Found** - The specified `classNumber` does not correspond to a known checkout snapshot.

value.ErrorMessage: Checkout snapshot not found for the given classNumber.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while validating the checkout snapshot.

value.ErrorMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

post.summary: (Deprecated) Place an order by converting a finalized cart or class into an order
post.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `POST /{classType}/{classNumber}/orders` instead.

Converts a finalized cart or class into a placed order. This is the final step in the checkout flow — after adding items, updating details, and finalizing pricing, call this endpoint to submit the order.

The request body allows specifying the user, order status, payment details, and additional instructions. On success, the response returns the generated order number.

**Related APIs:**
- **`PUT`** [Finalize a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/6b576bf493d0a)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Class Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/808308a389044)
- **`POST`** [Add Line Items to a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/128e56dad49c0)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Receipt Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/1084a3afb423f) 

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

put.summary: (Deprecated) Generate finalize number
put.description:
**Recommendation:** This endpoint is deprecated. Use `PUT /{classType}/{classNumber}/finalize-number` instead.

Generates a finalized number for the specified order class by triggering the finalization workflow.  Validates that the provided class type and class number are valid before executing the finalization. Returns the generated finalize number, class type, and operation status.

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

post.summary: Add one or more products to a shopping cart with quantity and options
post.description:
Adds one or more products to a shopping cart.

Creates a new cart if no cart number is provided, or adds items to an existing cart. The request body must include the product SKU(s) and quantities. The endpoint validates inventory availability, applies tier pricing rules, and calculates item-level totals. 

### Additional Cost Validation Rules

 - CostType is optional and can be set to null when there is only one additional cost entry for a given Code and Value within a line item. 
 - If multiple additional cost entries exist for the same line item with the same Code and Value, CostType is mandatory to differentiate those entries. 
 - When CostType is provided, the combination of SKU, Code, and CostType must be unique within the same line item. Duplicate combinations are not allowed. 

 **Example:**
 SKU: 'Z-100226' Code: 'Upcharge' CostType: 'FrontLogo' 

---

### Backorder Estimate

When the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled, adding items to a cart also saves the estimated backorder quantity and date against the cart line items. The estimate is recalculated when the order is placed. A failure to save the estimate does not affect the add-to-cart result, and the response body is unchanged.

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Get cart items.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/c94c72726ba3e)
- **`DELETE`** [Delete all items from a cart.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/c89a9d560f592)
- **`DELETE`** [Purge abandoned carts.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/e4094d545209b)

The unique identifier of the authenticated user making the request. For guest users, the value must be `0`. For retail or B2B users, provide the actual `UserId`. This header determines user-level context for personalization, pricing tiers, and order ownership.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList)

**How to Retrieve UserId:**
1. Go to Accounts & Users → Users in the Admin panel.
2. Edit the desired User.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description:
Specifies which additional pricing components to include in the response. By default (when no expand keys are provided), only **SubTotal** and **Total** are returned.

### Supported Expand Keys

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| Discount | Includes item-level and order-level discount breakdowns (promotion, coupon, and CSR discounts). |
| Shipping | Includes shipping cost, shipping discount, and shipping method details. |
| Tax | Includes tax cost, tax rate, and sales tax breakdowns. |
| Voucher | Includes voucher (gift card) amounts applied and voucher validation details. |

**Examples:**
- Single key: `expand=Discount`
- Multiple keys: `expand=Discount&expand=Shipping&expand=Tax&expand=Voucher`

get.summary: Retrieve the list of line items for a specific class of any type
get.description:
Returns the list of line items (products, SKUs, quantities, pricing) associated with a specific class. Use this to inspect the contents of an order, cart, quote, or saved cart before further processing.

**Related APIs:**
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Class Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/808308a389044)
- **`POST`** [Add Line Items to a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/128e56dad49c0)
- **`PUT`** [Update Bulk Quantity on a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/ce30892f52bf6)
- **`PUT`** [Update Custom Data on a Line Item](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/44cd33ffd1728)  

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

### Backorder Information

Each line item, and each bundle, grouped or configurable child item and add-on, can include **BackOrderQuantity** and **BackOrderDate**, together with a **BackOrderDetails** list of all backordered SKUs.

- **Carts, checkout and quotes** - an estimate based on current inventory, returned only when the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled. When the setting is off, no backorder details are returned. For carts and checkout, the estimate is also saved with the line items.
- **Orders** - the quantity and date saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.
- **Approval-routed (pending) orders** - the values saved when the order was placed, returned regardless of the setting.

delete.summary: Delete a specific line item from a class by the provided item identifier
delete.description:
Permanently removes a specific line item from a class (order, cart, quote, or saved cart) by its item ID. Once deleted, the line item is no longer part of the class and the class totals are recalculated.

**Related APIs:**
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Item List for a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/632718385de54)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Class Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/808308a389044)
- **`POST`** [Add Line Items to a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/128e56dad49c0)
- **`PUT`** [Update Bulk Quantity on a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/ce30892f52bf6) 

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

post.summary: Copy an existing class into a new class
post.description:
Creates a copy of an existing class (cart, order, quote, or saved cart) into a new class of the type specified by `TargetClassType`. Use this to duplicate content for reorders, templates, or workflow transitions without modifying the original.

On success, the response returns the class number of the newly copied class.

> **Authentication required** — see the Authorization header in the Request section.

**Warning:** Each invocation of this API creates a new class copy and generates a new class number. Repeated calls for the same source class will result in multiple duplicate class records being created in the database. Since this is a resource-intensive operation involving bulk data copy, unnecessary or repeated executions can lead to data duplication and may negatively impact system performance. It is strongly recommended to check for an existing active copied class (for example, an existing Quote Number) and reuse it whenever possible, rather than invoking this API multiple times.

### Same-User Copy
 

- The copied class is created under the **same user** who owns the source class.
- No additional validations are executed — no user lookup, no account check, no portal access check.
- Order addresses, `OrderAddressId` on payment, and `OrderAddressId` on shipment are all **preserved as-is** on the copied quote.
     
### Scope

The `{classType}` route parameter is generic and the endpoint accepts any class type (`Quotes`, `Carts`, `Orders`, `SavedCarts`, `OrderTemplates`, `ApprovalRoutings`, etc.).

### What Gets Copied

| Data | Same-User Copy  |
|---|---|
| Line items, quantities, custom data, configuration | ✅ Copied | 
| Payment details (totals, card type, payment token) | ✅ Copied |
| Discount details | ✅ Copied |
| Order addresses (`ZnodeOrderAddress`) | ✅ Copied — source address rows merged into target order |
| `OrderAddressId` FK in `ZnodeOrderAddress` | ✅ Preserved — points to the copied billing address row |
| `OrderAddressId` FK in `ZnodeOrderShipment` | ✅ Preserved — points to the copied shipping address row |
| Pricing, account pricing tiers, promotions | ❌ **Not recalculated** — prices are carried over as-is |
| Obsolete or inactive products | ⚠️ Copied as-is — no availability check at copy time |

> ⚠️ **Credit card orders:** It is recommended not to copy classes that were placed using a credit card.

### Post-Copy Recommended Actions

The following endpoints bring the copied quote to a consistent state. They apply to **copies** — prices are never recalculated at copy time regardless of copy type.

- **POST** [Reset prices of specified order line items to their original catalog prices](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/bb8bf67690641-reset-prices-of-specified-order-line-items-to-their-original-catalog-prices) - ```/commerceapi/v1/lineitems/reset-line-item-prices```
	- Resets the prices of specified line items to their current catalog prices, applying tier pricing, account pricing, and promotions for the target user. Call this after a copy to ensure the copied quote reflects the target user's correct pricing rather than the source user's prices.
- **GET** [Validate all cart items for inventory, pricing, and product status](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/d488b6863ed23-validate-all-cart-items-for-inventory-pricing-and-product-status-issues) - ```/commerceapi/v1/carts/validate-cart/{cartNumber}```
	- Validates **all** line items in a quote/cart in a single call. More efficient than validating items one-by-one when the copied quote may contain many line items.

**Related APIs:**
- `GET` [Retrieve a paginated list of order classes from a cached source](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Get-Classes/List) — Retrieves a paginated list of order classes from a cached source.
- `GET` [Retrieve order class details by the provided unique order class identi](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Get-Classes/OrderClass) — Retrieves order class details by the provided unique order class identifier.
- `PUT` [Update an existing order class configuration using the provided reques](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Put-Classes/Update) — Updates an existing order class configuration using the provided request.
- `DELETE` [Delete an order class identified by its unique CP order class identifi](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/Delete-Classes/Delete) — Deletes an order class identified by its unique CP order class identifier.

get.summary: Validate Checkout Session
get.description:
Validates the current state of a checkout snapshot identified by the provided classNumber.

In the default implementation, this endpoint is invoked only during the final checkout transaction steps to ensure that the checkout session is still valid before executing an irreversible action.

The validation is performed before the following operations:
- Place Order
- Submit for Approval
- Pay & Submit (Online Payment)

If the checkout snapshot is no longer valid, the requested operation is blocked and an appropriate response is returned to the client.

A checkout snapshot may become invalid for reasons such as:
- The checkout session has expired.
- A newer checkout snapshot has been created for the same cart.
- The checkout has been opened or continued in another tab or browser session, making the previous snapshot inactive.
- The provided checkout reference or class number is invalid.
- The checkout session no longer exists.

> **Note:** In the default implementation, checkout snapshot validation is performed only before the final transaction steps and is not continuously executed throughout the checkout flow. This behavior can be customized based on business requirements.

**Related APIs:**
- **`POST`** [Copy a Class (Create Checkout Snapshot)](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/37f377d95d2ec)
- **`POST`** [Place an Order](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/829b5bf9bdff7)

parameters.name: classNumber
parameters.description:
**Class Number** - The unique checkout snapshot number to validate (e.g., `CO-07042026-03375`).

> **Note:** The checkout snapshot `classNumber` is not displayed in the Admin application. It is available only in the response of the Copy Class API when the checkout snapshot is created.

**Reference:** [List of classes of specified class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/f3b6637fbc23d)

200.description: **OK** - The checkout snapshot validation completed. The response contains the snapshot state, expiry date, and any error message.

204.description: **No Content** - The validation completed but produced no result. The checkout snapshot may not exist or the session produced no state.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request is invalid. This occurs when `classNumber` is missing or not in the correct format.

value.ErrorMessage: Invalid or missing classNumber parameter.

401.description: **Unauthorized** - The request failed because the Authorization header is missing or the token/API key is invalid or expired.

value.ErrorMessage: Authorization failed. Invalid or missing credentials.

404.description: **Not Found** - The specified `classNumber` does not correspond to a known checkout snapshot.

value.ErrorMessage: Checkout snapshot not found for the given classNumber.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while validating the checkout snapshot.

value.ErrorMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

post.summary: Place an order by converting a finalized cart or class into an order
post.description:
Converts a finalized cart or class into a placed order. This is the final step in the checkout flow — after adding items, updating details, and finalizing pricing, call this endpoint to submit the order.

The request body allows specifying the user, order status, payment details, and additional instructions. On success, the response returns the generated order number.

**Related APIs:**
- **`PUT`** [Finalize a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/6b576bf493d0a)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Class Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/808308a389044)
- **`POST`** [Add Line Items to a Class](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/128e56dad49c0)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve Receipt Details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/commerce-api/branches/main/1084a3afb423f) 

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

Znode.Libraries.Abstract.Helper.FilterTu.description: Represents a single filter condition for querying or deleting custom table data. A FilterTuple consists of three main components: **filterName** (the column to filter on), **filterOperator** (the comparison operator), and **filterValue** (the value to compare). Multiple FilterTuple objects are combined with AND logic in filter arrays.

Item1.description: Legacy tuple property. Represents the first component of the filter tuple. This property is deprecated in favor of **FilterName**, **FilterOperator**, and **FilterValue** properties. Included for backward compatibility.

Item2.description: Legacy tuple property. Represents the second component of the filter tuple. This property is deprecated in favor of **FilterName**, **FilterOperator**, and **FilterValue** properties. Included for backward compatibility.

Item3.description: Legacy tuple property. Represents the third component of the filter tuple. This property is deprecated in favor of **FilterName**, **FilterOperator**, and **FilterValue** properties. Included for backward compatibility.

FilterName.description: The name of the column or field in the custom table to apply the filter on. This must correspond to an actual column in the target custom table.

FilterOperator.description: The comparison operator to use for filtering. **Supported values:** eq (Equals), ne (NotEquals), cn (Contains), ncn (NotContains), sw (StartsWith), ew (EndsWith), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), lk (Like), nlk (NotLike), is (Is), in (In), not in (NotIn), bw (Between). The operator determines how the **FilterValue** is compared against the column data.

FilterValue.description: The value to compare against using the specified **FilterOperator**. The format and interpretation depend on the operator and the target column's data type. For **bw** (Between) operator, use comma-separated values (e.g., '100,200'). For **in** and **not in** operators, use comma-separated values (e.g., 'value1,value2,value3').

Indicates the final decision returned by the Fraud Management Engine (FME) after evaluating the transaction processed through the CyberSource payment gateway.
Possible values are:
- Review: The transaction requires manual review before a final decision can be made.
- Reject: The transaction has failed the evaluation and must not proceed.
- Success: The transaction has passed the evaluation with no further action required.
This field will be null for transactions processed using non-CyberSource payment methods.

CustomerEmail.description: **Customer Email** - The email address of the customer associated with this class. Used for order confirmations and return communications.

StoreName.description:

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Locate the desired store in the grid.
3. The **Store Name** is displayed in the Store Name column.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

Total.description:
**Total** - The total amount for this line item or order, calculated from quantity, unit price, taxes, shipping, and applied discounts.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Order List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Order/List)

**How to Retrieve Total:**
1. Go to OMS → Orders → List in the Admin panel.
2. Open the desired Order.
3. Navigate to Manage → Summary.
4. The Total Amount value is the `total`.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Orders](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756889-managing-orders)

CreatedByFullName.description:
**Created By Full Name** - The full name of the user or CSR who created this class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList)

UserFullName.description: **User Full Name** - The full name of the user who owns this class. Empty when the class belongs to a guest user.

ModifiedByFullName.description:
**Modified By Full Name** - The full name of the user or CSR who last modified this class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList)

ModifiedDate.description:
**Modified Date** - The timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.

**Note:** The date and time format in the response depends on the **DateFormat** and **TimeFormat** configured under [General Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/GeneralSetting/List).

AssignToFullName.description:
**Assign To Full Name** - The full name of the CSR to whom this class (typically a quote or order) is assigned for processing. Empty when unassigned.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList).

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Users](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756985-managing-users)

CultureCode.description:
**Culture Code** - The culture / locale code that governs language, currency, and regional formatting for this class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Locale List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Locale/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Locale List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Locale/List).

LineItemDetails.description: **Line Item Details** - The list of line items (SKUs) contained in this class, including quantities, pricing, personalization, and validation state for each item.

OrderShipments.description: **Order Shipments** - The list of shipment records generated for this class, including ship dates, tracking numbers, and shipping method details.

OrderDiscounts.description:
**Order Discounts** - The list of order-level discounts applied to this class, including promotions, coupons, and CSR discretionary discounts.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Order List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Order/List)

CostFactorResponse.description: **Cost Factor Response** - The list of additional cost components applied to this class (e.g., surcharges, handling fees, gift-wrap fees).

Address.description: **Address** - The list of addresses associated with this class. Typically includes both billing and shipping addresses.

WareHouseAddress.description: **Warehouse Address** - The list of warehouse / fulfillment-center addresses from which line items in this class will ship.

ExpirationDate.description:
**Expiration Date** - The date and time when this class expires. Applies primarily to quotes and saved carts; after expiration the class can no longer be converted to an order.

**Note:** The date and time format in the response depends on the **DateFormat** and **TimeFormat** configured under [General Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/GeneralSetting/List).

PhoneNumber.description:
**Phone Number** - The primary contact phone number of the customer associated with this class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList).
2. Locate the desired user in the grid.
3. Click Edit - the **Phone Number** is visible in the user profile form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Users](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756985-managing-users)

InHandDate.description:
**In Hand Date** - The requested in-hand delivery date for this order. Shipping methods and expedited options are selected to satisfy this date when provided.

**Note:** The date and time format in the response depends on the **DateFormat** and **TimeFormat** configured under [General Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/GeneralSetting/List).

PaymentDetails.description:
**Payment Details** - The payment method, transaction token, and gateway-status information recorded against this class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Order List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Order/List)

AdditionalInstructions.description: **Additional Instructions** - Free-form fulfillment, handling, or customer-note instructions attached to this class. Rendered as a list of named instruction blocks.

AssignToUserId.description:
**Assign To User ID** - The numeric user ID of the CSR to whom this class is assigned for processing. `0` or null when unassigned.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [User List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Customer/CustomersList).
2. Locate the desired user in the grid.
3. Click Edit and read the `userId` query-string value in the browser URL.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Users](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756985-managing-users)

LinkedClassNumber.description:
**Linked Class Number** - The class number of a related class (for example, the quote that originated this order). Empty when this class has no linked class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Order List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Order/List)

**How to Retrieve ClassNumber (from Query String):**
1. Go to OMS > Orders > List in the Admin panel.
2. Open the desired Order.
3. Navigate to Manage.
4. Check the browser URL and locate `ClassNumber=`.
5. The value next to it is the classNumber.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Orders](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756889-managing-orders)

ConvertedClassNumber.description:
**Converted Class Number** - The class number created when this class was converted (for example, the order created from this quote). Empty when no conversion has occurred.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Order List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Order/List)

**How to Retrieve ClassNumber (from Query String):**
1. Go to OMS > Orders > List in the Admin panel.
2. Open the desired Order.
3. Navigate to Manage.
4. Check the browser URL and locate `ClassNumber=`.
5. The value next to it is the classNumber.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Orders](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756889-managing-orders)

CustomData.description: **Custom Data** - Dynamic key/value pairs attached to this class through the Custom Data framework. Used for extending the schema without requiring code changes.

ExternalId.description: **External ID** - An optional identifier used by external systems (ERP, PIM, third-party integrations) to reference this class.

LocaleCode.description:
Represents a specific geographic or cultural region for the request. Controls which localized content, product attributes, and translations are returned. If not provided, the system default locale is used.

**Reference:** [Get Default Locale Details by Domain Name](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/operations/get-Domain-GetDefaultLocaleFromDomain)

PortalCode.description:
The unique store code identifier of the portal (storefront). Specifies the store context for this record, affecting pricing, inventory, promotions, and locale settings.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to the Store List page in the Admin panel.
2. The store code is displayed in the list for each store.
3. Alternatively, click Edit on a store - the `StoreCode` field is visible on the configuration page.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

PublishCatalogCode.description:
**Publish Catalog Code** - The code of the published catalog used by this class for product availability, pricing tiers, and category assignments.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Catalog List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Catalog/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Catalog List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Catalog/List).
2. Locate the desired published catalog in the grid.
3. The **Catalog Code** and **Catalog Name** are displayed in their respective columns.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Catalogs](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000761617-managing-catalogs)

PublishCatalogName.description:
**Publish Catalog Name** - The display name of the published catalog used by this class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Catalog List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Catalog/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Catalog List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Catalog/List).
2. Locate the desired published catalog in the grid.
3. The **Catalog Code** and **Catalog Name** are displayed in their respective columns.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Catalogs](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000761617-managing-catalogs)

SubTotal.description:
**Sub Total** - The total for all line items before taxes, shipping, and order-level discounts are applied.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Order List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Order/List)

**How to Retrieve SubTotal:**
1. Go to OMS → Orders → List in the Admin panel.
2. Open the desired Order.
3. Navigate to Manage → Summary.
4. The Subtotal value is the `SubTotal`.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Orders](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756889-managing-orders)

CurrencySuffix.description:
**Currency Suffix** - The currency symbol or suffix used for display purposes (e.g., `$`, `€`, `£`).

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Open the desired store and go to the **Currency** section.
3. The configured currency code and symbol are displayed there.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

CurrencyCode.description:
**Currency Code** - The ISO-4217 currency code used for all monetary values in this class.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Open the desired store and go to the **Currency** section.
3. The configured currency code and symbol are displayed there.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

StatusCode.description: **Status Code** - The machine-readable status code for this class. Commonly used to drive UI and workflow decisions.

IsGuestUser.description: **Is Guest User** - `true` when this class belongs to an unauthenticated (guest) user; `false` when a registered user owns the class.

AccountName.description:
**Account Name** - The display name of the B2B account associated with this class. Empty when no account is linked.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Account List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Account/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Account List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Account/List).

3. The **Account Name** is displayed in the Account Name column.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Accounts](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756944-managing-accounts)

IsTaxExempt.description:
**Is Tax Exempt** - `true` when the account or user associated with this class is configured as tax-exempt; `false` otherwise.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Account List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Account/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Account List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Account/List).
2. Open the desired account.
3. The **Tax Exempt** toggle is visible in the account configuration.

**Knowledgebase:** [Configuring Taxes for a Store](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756987-configuring-taxes-for-a-store)

FinalClassNumber.description:
**Final Class Number** - The finalised class number assigned once this class transitions out of draft or processing state. Matches `ClassNumber` when no renumbering occurs.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Order List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Order/List)

**How to Retrieve ClassNumber (from Query String):**
1. Go to OMS > Orders > List in the Admin panel.
2. Open the desired Order.
3. Navigate to Manage.
4. Check the browser URL and locate `ClassNumber=`.
5. The value next to it is the classNumber.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Orders](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756889-managing-orders)

AccountCode.description:
**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Account List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Account/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to Accounts & Users > Accounts > Edit in the Admin panel.
