Znode.Engine.CommercePortal.Models.Respo.description: Represents detailed information about a line item in an order.

CreatedDate.description: **Created Date** - Represents the date and time when the line item was originally added to the cart. The value is immutable and does not change during subsequent updates or transactions.

ModifiedDate.description: **Modified Date** - Represents the date and time of the most recent modification associated with the line item. The value may be updated as a result of subsequent transactions or processes involving the line item.

ItemId.description: **Item ID** - The unique identifier of this line item within its parent class.

ProductName.description:
**Product Name** - The display name of the product on this line.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.
3. Click **Edit** — this field is visible in the product form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757187-managing-products)

ProductDescription.description:
**Product Description** - A short description of the product on this line.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.
3. Click **Edit** — this field is visible in the product form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757187-managing-products)
ProductDescription.example: 20V cordless drill with two batteries and charger.

PersonalizedDetails.description: **Personalized Details** - Personalisation entries (monogramming, engraving, custom text) attached to this line item.

Quantity.description: **Quantity** - The number of units of the SKU ordered on this line.

UnitPrice.description:
**Unit Price** - The per-unit price at the time the line was added to the class, before line-level discounts.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.
3. Click **Edit** and go to the **Pricing** tab to view configured unit prices.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Pricing for a Product](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757029-managing-pricing-for-a-product)

AddOnSkuList.description: **Add-On SKU List** - Add-on SKUs (e.g., warranty, accessory) bundled with this line item.

Sku.description:
**SKU** - The stock-keeping unit (unique product code) of the line item.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.
3. Click **Edit** — the **SKU** is displayed in the **General Info** section.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757187-managing-products)

AlternateSku.description:
**Alternate SKU** - A secondary SKU used for external systems or supplier mappings.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.
3. Click **Edit** — the **SKU** is displayed in the **General Info** section.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757187-managing-products)

ChildItemList.description: **Child Item List** - Child items when this line represents a kit, bundle, or configurable product.

GroupCode.description: **Group Code** - The grouping code that ties related line items together (e.g., kit components sharing a parent).

Attributes.description: **Attributes** - Product attribute values selected for this line item (size, colour, finish, etc.).

CustomData.description: **Custom Data** - Dynamic key/value pairs attached to this line item via the Custom Data framework.

ValidationDetails.description: **Validation Details** - Validation messages (errors, warnings) raised for this line, for example inventory or pricing violations.

AdditionalCost.description: **Additional Cost** - Additional cost components applied to this line (e.g., surcharges, gift-wrap, handling).

ProductImagePath.description:
**Product Image Path** - Absolute URL to the primary product image used for display.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.
3. Click **Edit** — this field is visible in the product form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757187-managing-products)

ProductType.description: **Product Type** - The Znode product type: `SimpleProduct`, `ConfigurableProduct`, `GroupedProduct`, or `BundleProduct`.

SEOUrl.description:
**SEO URL** - The search-friendly URL path of the product on the storefront.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.

ItemPrice.description: **Item Price** - The effective per-unit price after line-level discounts have been applied.

TotalPrice.description: **Total Price** - The total price for this line (`ItemPrice` × `Quantity` + applicable taxes and costs).

StatusCode.description: **Status Code** - The fulfilment status of this line item (e.g., `Pending`, `Shipped`, `Returned`, `Cancelled`).

StatusName.description: **Status Name** - The human-readable fulfilment status of this line item.

ShippingCost.description: **Shipping Cost** - The shipping cost allocated to this line item.

PerQuantityShippingCost.description: **Per Quantity Shipping Cost** - The shipping cost per unit for this line item (used for weight- or piece-based shipping).

AvailableQuantity.description:
**Available Quantity** - The quantity currently available in inventory for this SKU.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Locate the desired product in the grid.
3. Click **Edit** and go to the **Inventory** tab to view quantity levels.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757187-managing-products)

ConfirmedQuantity.description:
**Confirmed Quantity** - The quantity confirmed for fulfilment on this line after inventory allocation.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Product List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

2. Locate the desired product in the grid.

IsReturnShipping.description: **Is Return Shipping** - `true` when the return shipping cost is covered by the merchant; `false` when the customer pays.

TotalDiscount.description: **Total Discount** - Total discount amount applied to this line (promotion + coupon + CSR).

TotalTaxCost.description: **Total Tax Cost** - Total tax applied to this line item.

TaxRate.description: **Tax Rate** - Effective tax rate applied to this line expressed as a percentage string.

IsPriceUpdated.description: Indicates whether the price has been updated.

BackOrderQuantity.description: **Back Order Quantity** - The quantity of the item that is on backorder. For orders, the value saved when the order was placed. For carts, checkout and quotes, an estimate based on current inventory, returned only when the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled.

BackOrderDate.description: **Back Order Date** - The expected availability date of the backordered quantity. For orders, the value saved when the order was placed. For carts, checkout and quotes, an estimate based on current inventory, returned only when the **Show Estimated Backorder Date & Quantity** global setting is enabled.

BackOrderDetails.description: **Back Order Details** - The backorder details of all backordered SKUs associated with the item (the item itself, bundle items and add-ons).

DiscountType.description: **Discount Type.** Specifies the type of promotion to apply to the class. This field is required.

2. Locate the desired promotion and view its associated coupon code.

Amount.description: **Manual CSR discount amount.** The fixed monetary value to deduct from the class total when applying a Customer Service Representative (CSR) discount. This is a client-supplied numeric value entered by the CSR at the time of the transaction; it is not configured or retrieved from the Admin panel. Leave empty or set to `0` when applying a promotion coupon code or voucher.

Expands.description: **Related resources to include in the response.** A collection of resource names whose details should be expanded in the calculated response. Values provided here are combined with any values supplied via the `expand` query parameter.

IsDiscountValid.description: **Indicates whether the discount is valid.** Accepted as part of the request payload; it is not evaluated when applying or removing a discount.

DiscountMessage.description: **A message describing the discount status.** Accepted as part of the request payload; it is not evaluated when applying or removing a discount.

DiscountStatus.description: The status of the discount (e.g., Applied, Expired, Invalid).

CalculatedDetails.description: Calculated details after discount and promotion processing.

DiscountId.description: The unique identifier of the discount record.

IsSuccess.description: Indicates whether the operation completed successfully. `true` if succeeded, `false` if failed.

IsValid.description: Indicates whether the discount/promotion is valid for this order.
